list.name: workload
list.label: Workload
list.definition: query_result(max by (owner_name) (max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"))))

query.query: query_result(max by (owner_name) (max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"))))

panels.title: CPU by namespace
panels.description: CPU usage in cores per selected namespace, stacked. Click a namespace to show its workloads below. From cAdvisor: each pod's containers, leaving out the pod-level cgroup, which would count them twice.

panels.title: Memory by namespace
panels.description: Memory working set per selected namespace, stacked: what the kernel counts against a limit. Click a namespace to show its workloads below. From cAdvisor: each pod's containers, leaving out the pod-level cgroup, which would count them twice.

panels.title: CPU by workload
panels.description: CPU usage in cores per workload in the selected namespaces, stacked. Click a workload to show its pods below. A pod's workload is what owns it: a ReplicaSet, DaemonSet, StatefulSet or Job, or for a static pod, its node. A pod without an owner shows under its own name. From cAdvisor: each pod's containers, leaving out the pod-level cgroup, which would count them twice.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, owner_name) (sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (owner_name) max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Memory by workload
panels.description: Memory working set per workload in the selected namespaces, stacked. Click a workload to show its pods below. A pod's workload is what owns it: a ReplicaSet, DaemonSet, StatefulSet or Job, or for a static pod, its node. A pod without an owner shows under its own name. From cAdvisor: each pod's containers, leaving out the pod-level cgroup, which would count them twice.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, owner_name) (sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (owner_name) max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")))

panels.title: CPU per pod
panels.description: CPU usage in cores of each of the selected workloads' pods, one line each: lines that rise together mean the workload, one line apart means that pod or its node. Dashed: each workload's request and limit for a typical pod, the median of its pods' totals. The limit is missing if no container has one.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod, node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>", owner_name=~"$workload"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>", pod=~"$workload"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"))

quantile by (namespace, owner_name) (0.5, sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (owner_name) max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>", owner_name=~"$workload"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>", pod=~"$workload"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")))

quantile by (namespace, owner_name) (0.5, sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (owner_name) max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>", owner_name=~"$workload"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>", pod=~"$workload"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Memory per pod
panels.description: Memory working set of each of the selected workloads' pods, one line each. A pod that reaches its limit is OOMKilled. Dashed: each workload's request and limit for a typical pod, the median of its pods' totals. The limit is missing if no container has one.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod, node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>", owner_name=~"$workload"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>", pod=~"$workload"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"))

quantile by (namespace, owner_name) (0.5, sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (owner_name) max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>", owner_name=~"$workload"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>", pod=~"$workload"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")))

quantile by (namespace, owner_name) (0.5, sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (owner_name) max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>", owner_name=~"$workload"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>", pod=~"$workload"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")))

panels.title: CPU throttled per pod
panels.description: Share of CFS periods in which a pod's containers hit their CPU limit and were paused. Only containers with a CPU limit are throttled, so pods without one show nothing.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod, node) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, pod, node) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>", owner_name=~"$workload"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>", pod=~"$workload"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Restarts per pod
panels.description: Container restarts of each pod per interval, from kube-state-metrics.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"} - kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"} offset $__interval) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>", owner_name=~"$workload"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>", pod=~"$workload"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Last termination
panels.description: Why and when each container of the selected workloads' pods last stopped, from kube-state-metrics. Unknown usually means its node restarted.

targets.expr: max by (pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_timestamp{namespace=~"$namespace"} * 1000 * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$namespace"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, owner_name) (last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind!~"|<none>", owner_name=~"$workload"}[5m]) or label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind=~"|<none>", pod=~"$workload"}[5m]), "owner_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)")))
